Story.Name: Story_lingshi_fenjie
Story.Desc: 分解蕴灵石转化为残片，等级越高的灵石获得残片越多

li.OKResult: local itemobj = story:GetBindThing() local name = itemobj:GetName() local count = itemobj.Count local count2 = nil print(name) if name == "蕴灵石-初" then count2 = 7 elseif name == "蕴灵石-中" then count2 = 28 elseif name == "蕴灵石-高" then count2 = 64 elseif name == "蕴灵石-极" then count2 = 156 elseif name == "蕴灵石-宝" then count2 = 306 elseif name == "蕴灵石-灵" then count2 = 538 elseif name == "蕴灵石-法" then count2 = 796 elseif name == "蕴灵石-尊" then count2 = 1120 elseif name == "蕴灵石-圣" then count2 = 1980 elseif name == "蕴灵石-道" then count2 = 3840 end me:AddMsg("[NAME]分解了[color=#363636]"..name.."[/color]共[color=#363636]"..count.."[/color]颗，每颗分解残片[color=#363636]"..count2.."[/color]个。本次获得："); me:DropAwardItem("Item_lingshi_canpian",count2*count); story:RemoveBindItem();

Story.Name: Story_lingshi_hundun
Story.Desc: 拥有着天地神物的混沌灵石，不知道会发生什么

li.OKResult: local LSjin = world:GetItemCount("Item_lingshi_jin11") local LSmu = world:GetItemCount("Item_lingshi_mu11") local LSshui = world:GetItemCount("Item_lingshi_shui11") local LShuo = world:GetItemCount("Item_lingshi_huo11") local LStu = world:GetItemCount("Item_lingshi_tu11") local LSyuan = world:GetItemCount("Item_lingshi_yuan11") local LShun = world:GetItemCount("Item_lingshi_hun11") local LS = math.min(LSjin,LSmu,LSshui,LShuo,LStu,LSyuan,LShun) if LS >= 1 then me:AddMsg(LS); else me:AddMsg("什么都没有发生"); end

Story.Name: Story_kuangshi_fenjie
Story.Desc: 一颗矿产中开采出来的原石，不知道里面有些什么

li.OKResult:
local itemobj = story:GetBindThing() local name = itemobj.def.ThingName local count = itemobj.Count local itkey = itemobj.Key local tian = math.floor((world.DayCount+101)/100) for i = 1, count do if name == "石矿" then nR = story.ItemCache elseif name == "玉矿" then nR = story.ItemCache2 elseif name == "灵矿" then nR = story.ItemCache3 end me:AddMsg("[color=#363636][NAME]分解了原石，本次获得：[/color]"); me:DropAwardItemFromCache(nR, 1, tian+1);
